messages:
michael torres: Heads-up: v4.1.0 pushed this morning. DeployBot reports failures in a subset of private (on-prem) customer clusters — permission denied on temp socket. DeployBot is recommending auto-rollback across all environments.
anya petrov: Wait on global auto-rollback. Private clusters are running an older infra image and require manual rollback coordination with the customer's infra team. Rolling back hosted/dedicated while private is in a broken partial state will cause client incompatibility.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary alarms: error-rate 4.2% on /v1/stream for release v4.1.0. Auto-rollback scheduled in 5m unless overridden. (reason: temp-sock-perm)
kim tran: Ops POV: we can isolate by route tag. Proposal: 1) Pin hosted + dedicated to v4.0.9 for 100% of traffic; 2) leave private clusters untouched and open a customer-action rollback runbook; 3) run a targeted patch (v4.1.1) to fix socket perms and redeploy to hosted/dedicated after test slice. If patch fails in 15m, then manual rollback for hosted/dedicated.
anya petrov: Agree. Private customers must approve out-of-band change. We should not touch their clusters without the customer.
sales-runner: Flagging that customer-ops contacts must be looped immediately. I'll draft a short external note once we decide.
ops-bot: Note: auto-rollback will trigger in 5m. Operator override required to cancel.
michael torres: Pin command for ops (example):
```bash
routectl set-weight --route api-global --version v4.0.9 --weight 100 --match-header "X-Env: hosted,dedicated"
```
kim tran: Executed pin. Verified: hosted+dedicated now 100% on v4.0.9. Test slice: v4.1.1-hotfix on 5% of internal test users.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary for v4.1.1-hotfix shows error-rate reduced to 0.3% on test slice. Auto-rollback cancelled by operator override.
anya petrov: Customer note draft (short): "We detected errors in on-prem clusters during this morning's release. We have isolated hosted and dedicated traffic to the previous stable version while we coordinate a rollback/patch with your ops team. Expect an update in 30 minutes."
sales-runner: Sending note to customer infra leads now. Also adding legal/compliance on the loop because private change touches their audit logs.
michael torres: Decision: no immediate global rollback. Action items: - kim: keep pin active and monitor 30m - anya: lead private customer coordination + get written approval for their rollback - devs: prepare reverse-migration steps if rollback becomes necessary - sales: send customer note and escalate to CSMs.
ops-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2087, severity: P2, scope: private cluster + hosted/dedicated isolation; mitigation: traffic pinned to previous stable for hosted/dedicated; private rollback coordinated with customer.
michael torres: I'll open the postmortem template and add a section on pre-deploy filesystem perm checks and a change-window reminder to notify private customers before infra-impacting releases. Thread closed once postmortem link added.
